Write the owner's words, with the time, as one unused answer in the owner channel of this repository's bus (~/.construct-owner/answers for the machine bus, ~/.construct-owner/answers/<repo-id> for a repository bus), the channel an owner decision is accepted from (construct say v<version>)

USAGE construct say [OPTIONS] 

OPTIONS

   --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)
  --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)
